title: A layered outer surface
hook: An animal’s outer covering can have several layers.

knows: Different fish can have different structures and behaviors.
doesNotKnow: The first panel shows overlapping scales; the blue outer line adds a schematic mucus layer. In many fishes scales and mucus contribute to protection, although coverings and functions vary between species. This enlarged section is not to scale.

misconception: The first imagined explanation must apply to this fish.
objective: In the pictured fish covering, what can lie outside overlapping scales?
